mainEntity.name: What is the typical process for kitchen wall removal?

acceptedAnswer.text: The typical process for kitchen wall removal involves an initial consultation and site assessment to determine if the wall is load-bearing. If it is, structural plans will be needed, often requiring a structural engineer. Next, permits are obtained, followed by demolition. Finally, necessary structural reinforcements like new headers or posts are installed, and finishing work is completed. As a process clarity detail, the need for structural engineering and permits can significantly impact the project timeline.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves assessment, structural planning if needed, permits, demolition, and structural reinforcement. Permits and engineering can affect the timeline.
